singleStateOwner: TeacherApplication.student -> TeacherStore.readSnapshot -> TeacherQueries -> existing projectLearningWork and buildTeacherWorkContext
bindingsOwner: learningWorkBindings.ts contains only reusable binding/selection assertions and exact retained-source score qualification; it creates no store, source acquisition or second state reducer.

explicitNamespaces.meaning: Opt-in literal keys from the maintained textbook read family; the student/course/book/paper/attempt tuple and retained source revision are all checked. Equal literals in legacy or other namespaces are not silently aliased. No native identity registration is inferred.

qualifiedBasis: Same owner/student partition and namespaced student/course/book assignment scope
Exact assignment revision, local attempt entity/revision, issuance key and explicit source paper/attempt crosswalk
Assignment, attempt and source revision must be retained heads; missing or replaced evidence stays unknown
Observed textbook source passes existing source audit and matches its original content digest and observation clock
refinements.view: Each exact attempt exposes assessmentTarget, scoreBasis and paired defaultClinicTargets. Only exact numeric100 excludes both defaults. Other verified scores require teacher selection; unresolved evidence stays unknown. No assignment is created or cancelled by this filter.
refinements.separation: Explicit later assignments/exceptions, raw source scores, teacher-reported originalScore, clinic final, activity review, app entry and physical stages remain independent.
refinements.coverageLimit: Unsupported read families or unqualified namespace/book/attempt crosswalks remain unknown. Retained-head qualification is not a new live acquisition or proof of authoritative currentness.

refinements.writeGuard: Existing owner ledger/student lock and CAS remain. New exact bindings must cite their attempt revision and match retained current assignment/items/attempt/issuance and student/owner scope.
refinements.identity: Legacy or explicit unknown reviews keep their old assignment-level entity. An exact new review has an attempt-and-revision-scoped entity suffix, preserving earlier originals rather than rebinding them.
refinements.view: Summary derives unknown for absent legacy bindings. Exact attempt activityReviews contain only qualified matching reviews; a grade/source revision cannot inherit its predecessor's inspection. Assignment-level teacher finals remain visible at their original scope.
refinements.coverageLimit: The existing student workspace port returns retained ledger heads. activityReviewCoverage explicitly does not claim complete review history; existing history/result APIs retain original access. Clinic completed remains its own exact item/attempt lane.

refinements.writeGuard: A new exact predecessor must be a retained current revision in the same student/course/book/user-course/registration scope. Self links, missing links, cross-scope references, entity cycles and competing successors are rejected. A known lineage cannot be silently dropped or rebound on a later revision.
refinements.view: Existing projection exposes obligationState, qualified lineage and currentObligations. Withdrawn and exactly replaced revisions are excluded; raw records, attempts and archived assignment versions remain. Unknown/invalid relationships cannot create cancellations. A later distinct predecessor revision is not silently cancelled.
refinements.oneSelection: selectEffectiveAssignments extracts the existing lesson-effective assignment selection and is reused by projection and transaction guards. Guards read retained history so a future successor revision cannot hide an already-effective replacement.
refinements.recovery: work_assignment_replaced is a proven terminal clinic refusal; the existing protected original request and refusal readback remain available without decision replay.
refinements.countingLimit: currentObligations means active retained explicit assignments with separate completion lanes, not a whole-student pending-homework count or full native inventory.

refinements.scope: Every known stage cites the exact issuance key and an observedAt clock no later than its teacher report. Stage reports are attributable teacher observations, not native execution receipts.
refinements.view: Absent stages derive independent unknowns. Known printing does not establish distribution; known distribution does not invent a print observation. Issuance identity, immutable ordered membership/reissue lineage, solving, source grade, correction, app entry and teacher final stay separate.
refinements.history: Existing append-only owner workspace versions retain previous stage observations and teacher originals. No payload normalization, backfill, schema migration or physical action is performed.

compatibility.payloads: Legacy exact-key validators still accept absent new optional fields. Views derive unknowns without adding properties to old payloads or changing their content/integrity digests.
compatibility.consumer: Existing teacher web filtering respects active obligations and retains a fallback for older serialized views without obligationState. New contracts require reviewed producer/consumer source adoption before emission in a native environment.
compatibility.sceneRevision: TeacherQueries includes the existing teacher workspace revision pins and updates its projection schema marker; readSnapshot ownership and source acquisition behavior are unchanged.
compatibility.neutralLeaves: All five QRY-BOUNDARY neutral leaves remain byte-identical to the qualified adoption Input.

verification.database: No synthetic PostgreSQL socket admitted. Pure shared guards and actual application/readSnapshot/request-recovery composition are checked; live transaction/CAS paths remain unexecuted.
verification.provenance: Root import-provenance verification reports existing boundary-adoption drift and additional maintained source edits. Reserved provenance manifests stay unchanged; root owns reconciliation after reviewing exact prepared source hashes.
verification.canonical: Root owns stage/commit and the committed exact snapshot plus semantic transition. No committed DOM-02 qualification or local result-durable milestone is claimed here.
